status: Bounded prefix-plus-correction implementation; source and packed local-ordering proofs complete

source.patchKind: Incremental binary-capable full-index Git diff against the exact private backup baseline, not a standalone patch against the public release

api.publication: publishAdvance({ batchId, nextCheckpoint, capture, approvePrefix: k, draft })
api.base: B = the same captured A followed by exactly its first k provisional revisions; excludes remaining P and all L
api.result: New A = B followed by fresh correction commits C. Accepted prefix revisions remain ancestors; remaining P rebases over C, then L rebases over the resulting sequenced history.
api.defaultPreserved: createDraft(capture) still starts at A; draft-only and pure-prefix publications remain supported
requirements: Same live controller and exact capture object for draft creation and publication
Finite integer prefix in the captured range, matching afterPrefix and approvePrefix
Expected checkpoint, exact prefix IDs and stable authoring-base revision checked on delivery
Fresh correction revision identities and original Fluid authoring contexts retained
Completion and checkout application only through sequenced self-echo
After externally completed OCS acceptance, a stale result requires reconciliation, not blind recapture/resubmission
api.undo: Ordinary SharedTree selective undo with preserved original ancestry; correction commits are not added to user undo stacks. Not a grouped normalized-action undo API.
